title: Northgate Purchases & Returns Return Terms Schedule: Windows, Non-Returnable Classes and Exchanges
content:
Merchandise bought through Northgate Purchases & Returns is returnable within a window that depends on its merchandise class, counted from the date recorded when the member received the merchandise (the fulfillment date). This schedule lists the class windows, the classes never returnable for a refund, the one channel with a channel-wide window, and the related terms each channel carries.

## Return window by merchandise class (identical on all six channels)

| Merchandise class | Return window, calendar days from the fulfillment date |
|---|---|
| major appliance | 90 |
| television | 90 |
| computer and tablet | 90 |
| cell phone | 90 |
| camera and drone | 90 |
| mattress and furniture | 120 |
| jewelry and watch | 365 |
| tires and batteries | 30 |
| grocery | no limit |
| general merchandise | no limit |

Never returnable for a refund on any channel: gasoline; tobacco and alcohol; Shop Card and gift card.

## Channel terms

| Channel | Channel-wide return window replacing every class window | Even exchange of the same item without a refund | Every accessory and part required on television, computer and tablet, cell phone and camera and drone returns |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate In-Club Purchase | 0 (none) | yes | yes |
| Northgate Club Pickup Order | 0 (none) | yes | yes |
| Northgate Same-Day Delivery Order | 0 (none) | no | yes |
| Northgate.com Ship-to-Home Order | 0 (none) | no | yes |
| Northgate Business Delivery Order | 0 (none) | no | yes |
| Northgate Special Order | 30 | no | yes |

On every channel the window counts from the fulfillment date, and a defect reported after the window is directed to the manufacturer's warranty or a Northgate Care protection plan.

Where accessories are required, a missing accessory or part is charged at its replacement cost.

## Points of judgement

- A channel-wide window of 0 means there is no override and the class window applies. The Northgate Special Order is the only channel with an override: 30 days for every returnable class, so a mattress bought as a special order has 30 days rather than 120.
- A class window of "no limit" never closes.

Hypothetical reading: a television bought as a Northgate In-Club Purchase has a 90-day window; the same television bought as a Northgate Special Order has a 30-day window.
